meta_description: Locks & Latches is your trusted emergency locksmith in Birmingham. Swift response, 24/7 availability, and fair pricing. Locked out? Call us now.
hero_eyebrow: 24/7 Emergency Callouts — Fast, Reliable, No Fuss
hero_subhead: We're here within the hour, day or night. Emergency locksmith response you can trust.
services_subhead: From locked-out homes to broken keys and commercial access issues, we fix it fast.

services.title: Emergency Lockout Assistance
services.desc: Stuck outside your home or office? We arrive swiftly with minimal damage to doors and frames. Same-day response, any time.

services.title: Lock Repairs & Replacements
services.desc: Broken or sticking locks repaired on the spot, or replaced with modern, secure alternatives. We carry stock for most domestic locks.

services.title: Broken Key Removal
services.desc: Snapped key stuck in the lock? We extract it safely without damaging the mechanism, then cut you a replacement.

services.title: Cylinder Lock Changes
services.desc: Lost keys or moving home? Fast cylinder replacement keeps your property secure and gives you peace of mind.

services.title: Commercial Access Solutions
services.desc: Offices, shops, and warehouses locked or barred? We're licensed for commercial callouts and work nights and weekends.

services.title: Boarding Up & Security
services.desc: After a break-in or forced entry? We secure your property urgently while you arrange permanent repairs.

about_pullquote: I built this on one promise: be there fast, fix it right, charge fair.
about_para_1: Locks & Latches started over a decade ago in Birmingham because I got sick of seeing people stranded outside their own homes. We've grown from a one-man operation to a trusted team handling hundreds of emergency callouts every month. We're available 24/7 because emergencies don't follow 9-to-5.
about_para_2: Our customers come back because we answer the phone, arrive quickly, and we don't rip you off. Whether you're locked out at 3am or need new locks after a house move, we treat your problem like it's our own. We've built our reputation one honest job at a time across Birmingham.
reviews_heading: What Birmingham Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Locked myself out on a Sunday evening and thought I was in for a long wait. Called Locks & Latches and someone was at my door in 45 minutes. Friendly guy, sorted the lock in 10 minutes, charged me fair. Brilliant.
reviews.author: David K.

reviews.text: Had a key snap off in my office lock on a Friday afternoon. They came out same day, got the broken bit out, and cut me a new key before 5pm. Couldn't have asked for better service. Will use them again.
reviews.author: Caroline M.

reviews.text: Called at midnight after breaking my key in the front door. Locksmith was with me by 12:45. Professional, quick, and the price was exactly what he quoted on the phone. Can't recommend enough.
reviews.author: Marcus T.
